_comment: What the phone queue serves, in priority order. Dataset ids may be globs
(fnmatch) against the lab catalog; a job whose pools resolve to nothing is
skipped silently so a fresh clone still gets a page. `mix` is the draw
probability per kind when the page is in Mix mode; captions are typing and
are deliberately not in the mix -- they have their own mode.
Order of value (see notes.md section 49): 2AFC pairs feed the human study
AND preference tuning; good/bad on the curated house caches cleans the SFT
set and gives a precision estimate for the curation gates; captions improve

Arms are pinned by id, not globbed over outputs/run_*: that directory is full of mock, smoke and pilot runs whose builds are not worth a human second. Add a new arm here when its bench run is the one being written up.

compare.question: Which looks more like a real Minecraft house?

caption.prompt: Describe it in one line, the way you would ask /gen for it.
